meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a healthy server when available and linking to official server setup guidance when needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Mattermost 机器人接进聊天频道,复用可用服务器并给出搭建指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你团队用 Mattermost,想让机器人常驻聊天频道。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team runs Mattermost and wants a bot living in its channels.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会带你接入 Mattermost 机器人频道：探测已有服务器、设置 SiteURL、复制适配器、创建并认证机器人、配置审批回调、解析你的私聊，再构建、测试、重启，之后你能在 Mattermost 私聊或频道里使用。
howto.when: 当你要求添加 Mattermost 频道时触发。它会先探测本机现有服务器，让你选择使用探测到的地址还是另输一个；找不到健康服务器时会给出官方部署指引。

say.text: 帮我添加一个 Mattermost 频道
say.note: 先探测有无可用服务器，再逐步接入
在提示时输入 use，沿用该地址

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through adding a Mattermost bot channel: it discovers a server, sets SiteURL, copies the adapter, creates and authenticates a bot, configures approval callbacks, resolves your DM, then builds, tests and restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Mattermost channel. It first probes for an existing server and asks whether to use the detected URL or enter another; if none is healthy it points to official server setup guidance.

say_en.text: Add a Mattermost channel for me
say_en.note: Probes for a healthy server, then walks through setup
Answer `use` at the prompt to keep that URL
Lets Mattermost reach back for approval cards
